headline: Cyclicals Carry the Tape at Midday as Chips and Security Software Sag
body_html:
Stocks are tilting firmly higher at midday Thursday, with 381 of the 536 names in our universe rising and 152 falling. The advance is led by economy-sensitive corners of the market: consumer shares are up 2.39%, homebuilders 2.23%, materials 1.63%, industrials 1.50% and healthcare 1.48%. Prices are still moving and are not final.

Technology is the soft spot. Semiconductors are down 0.75% and software is essentially flat, up 0.03%, though that average masks a wide split: Fortinet has dropped 21.49% while Donnelley Financial has climbed 12.03%. Marvell Technology is off 11.89% and FormFactor 8.53%, keeping the pressure on chip-related names. Energy is also lower, down 0.56%.

The standout mover is Glaukos, up 31.65% in the medical-device space, with Crocs rising 25.69% and Boot Barn 13.82%, underlining the consumer strength. Builders FirstSource is ahead 10.60%, fitting the homebuilding bid. On the downside, Alnylam is down 17.26%. Into the close, watch whether the cyclical leadership holds, whether chip weakness spreads, and how positioning looks heading into Friday, October 30.

briefs.headline: Glaukos surges more than 31% to top the board
briefs.body: Glaukos is the biggest gainer in our universe at midday, up 31.65%. The medical-device name is far ahead of every other mover, and it helps push healthcare up 1.48% as a group. Intraday gains of this size can fade, so the closing print matters.

briefs.headline: Crocs and Boot Barn power consumer shares
briefs.body: Consumer is the strongest sector at midday, up 2.39%. Crocs has jumped 25.69% and Boot Barn 13.82%, two footwear and retail names doing much of the heavy lifting. The move is notable for its concentration in apparel-related stocks.

briefs.headline: Homebuilders keep pace with the leaders
briefs.body: Homebuilders are up 2.23%, second only to consumer shares among our sector groups. Builders FirstSource has climbed 10.60%, one of the larger moves in the building-products space. Strength here suggests housing-linked names are sharing in the broad advance.

briefs.headline: Fortinet slides more than 21%, dragging on security software
briefs.body: Fortinet is the weakest stock in our universe at midday, down 21.49%. The drop contrasts with Donnelley Financial, up 12.03%, and leaves the software group almost unchanged at plus 0.03%. The sector's flat average hides sharp stock-specific moves.

briefs.headline: Chip names under pressure: Marvell and FormFactor lag
briefs.body: Semiconductors are down 0.75% as a group. Marvell Technology has fallen 11.89% and FormFactor, a chip-equipment name, is off 8.53%. Together they make semiconductors one of only two sectors in the red, alongside energy, which is down 0.56%.

briefs.headline: Alnylam falls 17% as healthcare still gains
briefs.body: Alnylam is down 17.26%, the second-weakest stock in our universe, even as healthcare overall rises 1.48%. The split shows how uneven the sector's advance is. Glaukos's large gain is lifting the group while biotech names like this one go the other way.
